name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines
notes: Bloodlines isn't documented (per PCGamingWiki) as having hardware EAX — its sound design is mostly scripted ambience rather than DirectSound3D reverb zones, so restoring EAX may make little to no audible difference here. That's expected, not a fault. (The earlier Vampire: The Masquerade – Redemption, 2000, is the EAX-capable one.)
